description: Send the win-back note to customers from customers.winBack: adds one service due date each (title, due in the shop's lead days), so the service_due_reminders job emails them once by the usual rules. Customers who can't be emailed, or who are no longer on the win-back list, are skipped and counted. Owner only. Needs service due emails on and the shop's mailing address. No texts.
name: customers_winBackQueue

next_actions.description: Up to 3 useful next steps, best first, in plain words. op names the op to call, when there is one. when is now, later, check, or tell_human. due_at is set for later and check when there is a natural time. A send is tell_human: show the owner the draft, then send only when they say so.
